reason: On my money £280 is a lot for wheels that probably come bare, and I'd still have to find the cash for tyres on top. Unless the tyres are good and included, I'm not spending it.
objection: Are the tyres any good? If they're not included or they're worn, I'm looking at another couple of hundred quid on top of the £280.
would_change_my_mind: Tyres included with decent stated tread depth (say 6mm+) at the same £280, or a clear price cut to around £200 so I can afford tyres separately.
